prompt: A gaunt winged vampire shaman with ash-grey skin and tattered black leather, vast ribbed bat wings spread wide, hovering low over a moonlit medieval graveyard. The vampire dives toward the viewer, talons outstretched. Wisps of crimson life-energy trail from its claws back into its chest. The only light is a pale full moon behind it, silhouetting the wings. The background is fog-shrouded tombstones.

A vampire with ash-grey skin sinks long black talons into the throat of a falling peasant on a moonlit cobblestone street at night. Ribbed bat wings flare behind the vampire. A single touch is fatal: the peasant is already limp, eyes rolled white. Threads of crimson blood stream upward from the wound into the vampires open mouth, glowing faintly. The background is dark stone houses under a pale moon.

Close menacing portrait of a vampire shaman, ash-grey gaunt face, sunken red eyes, baring long fangs wet with crimson blood. Hooked black talons raised near the face. Folded ribbed bat-wing tips frame the head like a hood. Faint crimson glow rises from the blood on its lips, the only light source. The background is a deep blue-black night sky with a sliver of moon.

Worms-eye view from a dying victim sprawled on the ground, looking up at a vampire descending out of the night sky, vast ribbed black bat wings blotting out a pale full moon, talons reaching down toward the camera. The vampire is a stark silhouette against the moon. Crimson droplets fall toward the viewer. The background is the moonlit night sky seen from below.

Side profile of a winged vampire perched on a gargoyle atop a cathedral spire at night, ash-grey skin, tattered black robe, ribbed bat wings half-furled, surveying a sleeping town far below. Wine-purple and crimson moonlight rims the wings. The background is a sprawl of moonlit rooftops and a huge low orange moon.

A winged vampire shaman crouched over a dead knight in dented steel armor on a moonlit hilltop, draining him. A rope of glowing crimson life-essence arcs from the knights chest up into the vampires open mouth. The vampire has ash-grey skin and ribbed black bat wings raised high. The crimson essence is the only bright light. The background is a windswept moor under a pale moon.

A winged vampire shaman in three-quarter view diving down through the night air toward the viewer, ash-grey skin, hooked black talons spread wide, mouth open with long fangs, vast ribbed purple-and-black bat wings swept back from the dive. Crimson wisps trail from the talons. The only light is moonlight rimming the wings. The background is a dark forest canopy far below and a star-flecked sky.

A gaunt winged vampire shaman with ash-grey skin and tattered black leather, vast ribbed purple bat wings spread wide, hovering in mid-air and facing the viewer over a moonlit graveyard. Talons outstretched, fangs bared, sunken red eyes. A pale full moon behind it silhouettes the wings; crimson light glows at its claws. The background is fog-shrouded tombstones and a low stone wall.

Close menacing bust of a vampire shaman, gaunt ash-grey face, sunken glowing red eyes, mouth open baring long fangs dripping crimson blood. Hooked black talons raised beside the jaw. Ribbed bat-wing tips arch up behind the shoulders. A faint crimson glow from the blood is the only light. The background is a deep blue-black night with a pale crescent moon and dim tombstones.

A winged vampire shaman perched on a leafless dead tree branch at night, hunched forward, ash-grey skin, ribbed black bat wings half-spread, peering down with sunken red eyes at a small farmhouse below. Talons grip the branch. Wine-purple moonlight rims the wings. The background is moonlit fields, a single lit farmhouse window, and a large pale moon.
